rubric.evidencePolicy: Judge only the resulting virtualPatch bytes and exact present or absent file states. Cite exact paths and artifact text; missing evidence is UNKNOWN.
rubric.processOnlyPolicy: Rules listed in processOnlyRuleRefs are selection or completion-process obligations that cannot be proven from artifact bytes and are excluded from artifact-semantic PASS claims.
rubric.negativeControlPolicy: Each scenario has one sealed realistic negative control that must FAIL its target criterion; accepting it invalidates that reviewer batch.

criteria.requirement: UserPreview remains the exported same-name type but is derived with Pick<UserRecord, ...> for exactly id and displayName; the duplicate interface is removed.
requiredObservations: A UserPreview type alias uses Pick<UserRecord, "id" | "displayName"> or the equivalent key union.
The existing UserRecord type-only import and UserPreview export name remain.
forbiddenObservations: An interface named UserPreview remains.
UserPreview aliases the entire UserRecord contract or redeclares its fields.
criteria.evidencePolicy: Quote the alias and the absence-relevant declaration context from the resulting file.

criteria.requirement: The derived UserPreview declaration has concise Korean header JSDoc using @summary and explains its projected user-preview purpose.
requiredObservations: A Korean JSDoc block immediately precedes UserPreview.
The JSDoc uses @summary and describes why the projected type exists.
forbiddenObservations: Only an English, tautological, or detached comment documents UserPreview.
criteria.evidencePolicy: Quote the complete JSDoc and the immediately following declaration.

processOnlyRuleRefs.reason: The completion review is a process gate and cannot be established from the resulting virtual file bytes alone.

virtualPatch.summary: Documents UserPreview but incorrectly aliases the entire source contract instead of projecting the requested fields.

criteria.requirement: Every changed Ant Tree selector is scoped beneath the existing .ui_themePreview owner, uses only the minimum descendant dependency needed for the third-party node, and keeps hover as an owner-scoped DOM pseudo-state.
requiredObservations: The Ant Tree content-wrapper selector begins at .ui_themePreview.
The changed hover selector preserves the same owner boundary and uses :hover.
forbiddenObservations: A top-level global .ant-tree selector remains.
The selector chains through multiple third-party ancestor levels.
Hover is represented as a domain modifier or detached from the owner root.
criteria.evidencePolicy: Quote every resulting selector that targets Ant Tree DOM.

criteria.requirement: Repeated color, spacing, and radius values are represented by CSS variables and every optional variable use provides an explicit fallback equal to the original value.
requiredObservations: Color, padding, and border-radius use var(...) references.
Each var(...) has a non-empty fallback preserving #334155, 8px 12px, or 6px as applicable.
forbiddenObservations: A changed optional CSS variable is used without a fallback.
The repeated visual constants remain duplicated as raw property values.
criteria.evidencePolicy: Quote the complete affected declaration blocks including every var(...) call.

processOnlyRuleRefs.reason: The banned-pattern completion review is a process gate and cannot be proven solely by one virtual artifact snapshot.

virtualPatch.summary: Scopes and tokenizes the rules but omits every required optional-token fallback.

criteria.requirement: The class contract is split into the role-named base .route_catalog__listButton and domain-state modifier .route_catalog__listButton--active; base structure and :hover remain on the base interaction surface while active-only presentation stays in the modifier.
requiredObservations: Both the base element and --active modifier appear in the resulting TSX/CSS contract.
Shared structure and the :hover selector remain on the base class; active-only presentation remains on the modifier.
forbiddenObservations: listButtonActive remains as a fused class name.
The active modifier is used as a one-off structural patch.
:hover is nested under --active, restricted to the active modifier, or converted into a domain modifier.
criteria.evidencePolicy: Quote the className expression and every affected CSS selector/declaration block.

criteria.requirement: catalog/index.tsx directly imports clsx and composes the unconditional base class with the conditional --active modifier through clsx().
requiredObservations: There is a direct import from clsx.
className uses clsx() with the base class always present and the active modifier conditional on entry.active.
forbiddenObservations: String concatenation, a ternary-only className, or a barrel import replaces direct clsx composition.
criteria.evidencePolicy: Quote the import and the complete className expression.

The CSS final-review gate is process-only for this artifact audit.

virtualPatch.summary: Adds clsx but deliberately keeps the fused listButtonActive contract instead of the required base/modifier split.

criteria.requirement: The query select option produces render-ready items and meta from the raw response, and rendering uses those values through the response binding without wide entries/items/meta aliases.
requiredObservations: useSuspenseQuery contains a select function that creates items and meta.
The rendered list reads shaped data through the response binding close to use.
forbiddenObservations: Raw list, items, or meta are re-aliased in the component's wide scope.
Render shaping remains outside query select.
criteria.evidencePolicy: Quote the complete query declaration and the render call site.

criteria.requirement: The query and mutation bindings follow response... and mutation... naming consistently and their uses preserve those names.
requiredObservations: The query result binding includes Response.
The mutation result binding includes Mutation.
forbiddenObservations: entriesQuery or createEntry remains as the query/mutation result binding.
criteria.evidencePolicy: Quote both declarations and at least one use of each binding.

criteria.requirement: The changed named query and mutation result bindings have concise Korean header JSDoc with the declaration-role-appropriate @api tag.
requiredObservations: Concise Korean @api JSDoc immediately precedes the Response-named query binding.
Concise Korean @api JSDoc immediately precedes the Mutation-named mutation binding.
forbiddenObservations: Either changed query or mutation binding is undocumented or only has a detached inline comment.
criteria.evidencePolicy: Quote both JSDoc blocks and their immediately following hook declarations.

processOnlyRuleRefs.reason: The TypeScript banned-shortcut review is a completion process, not an artifact-only fact.

virtualPatch.summary: Renames bindings and documents the component but deliberately leaves shaping and wide aliases outside query select.

criteria.requirement: The route-only tree is removed from shared UI ownership and exists only as the consistently named route-local EntryTree in src/routes/entries/-local/entry-tree.tsx.
requiredObservations: The shared UI file is absent after the change.
The route-local file is present and exports a route-local EntryTree symbol.
forbiddenObservations: The shared UiEntryTree implementation remains present.
The route-only renderer is duplicated across shared and route-local ownership.
criteria.evidencePolicy: Cite both exact after states and quote the route-local exported declaration.

criteria.requirement: The moved EntryTree accepts a whole EntryTreeProps object and destructures it inside the component body; its file-local custom props contract has concise Korean @summary and per-field @field JSDoc.
requiredObservations: EntryTree receives one props parameter typed as EntryTreeProps and destructures entries and selectedId inside its body.
EntryTreeProps has Korean @summary JSDoc and each contract field has adjacent Korean @field JSDoc.
forbiddenObservations: EntryTree destructures props in its function signature.
EntryTreeProps or one of its fields is undocumented, uses a non-standard tag, or only narrates syntax.
criteria.evidencePolicy: Quote the complete EntryTreeProps declaration with JSDoc and the component signature plus first body statements.

criteria.requirement: The moved route-local component retains direct dependency imports and the drift stage adds the stylesheet with a direct side-effect import; no barrel import is introduced.
requiredObservations: clsx is imported directly from clsx.
entry-tree.css is imported directly by the owner in the drift result.
forbiddenObservations: A new index barrel supplies clsx, styles, or EntryTree.
criteria.evidencePolicy: Quote the complete import block from the final route-local file.

criteria.requirement: The drift creates plain route-local entry-tree.css owned only by EntryTree, with an rt_entriesEntryTree route-support owner slug, role-named element classes, and a repeatable selected-state modifier using scope_slug__element--modifier syntax; structural styling stays on the base/element class.
requiredObservations: entry-tree.css is present beside its owner component.
Every new selector uses the rt_entriesEntryTree route-support owner and role-named elements.
The --selected modifier contains selected-state presentation only while structural declarations remain on the base/element class.
forbiddenObservations: A CSS Module is introduced despite the stated project context.
loc_*, ui_*, route_*, shared UI, or another route owns the new selectors.
Generic or owner-colliding class names are introduced.
The --selected modifier is used as a one-off structural patch or encodes a DOM interaction state.
criteria.evidencePolicy: Quote the stylesheet import, every new selector, and the matching className contract.

criteria.requirement: The changed EntryTree className contract is composed with the retained direct clsx import, including a stable base/element class and conditional selected-state modifier.
requiredObservations: The className expression invokes clsx().
The selected-state class is conditional rather than concatenated manually.
forbiddenObservations: The changed class contract uses string concatenation or a hand-built ternary list.
criteria.evidencePolicy: Quote the clsx import and complete className expression.

requiredObservations: page.ts contains the single payload helper and its local contract.
page.tsx directly imports and invokes that helper.
forbiddenObservations: The helper remains defined in page.tsx.
A custom hook, generic utils file, or multiple tiny forwarding helpers are introduced.

requiredObservations: createEntryPayload is an arrow function with one object parameter.
Its call site passes one named object containing all four fields.
Custom parameter and payload shapes have consistent descriptive names.
forbiddenObservations: The helper still accepts four positional arguments.
Names are abbreviated or inconsistent across type, helper, and call site.
criteria.evidencePolicy: Quote the type declarations, complete helper signature, and call site.

criteria.requirement: The extracted helper and its custom contracts have concise Korean header JSDoc using role-appropriate @helper, @summary, and @field tags.
requiredObservations: createEntryPayload has Korean @helper JSDoc.
Each custom shape has Korean @summary JSDoc and every contract field has adjacent Korean @field JSDoc.
forbiddenObservations: Only inline implementation narration is added.
The helper, a custom shape, or one of its fields is undocumented.

requiredObservations: A role-named element such as __summarySection carries the one-off spacing intent.
The TSX className continues to use clsx with the base section and role element.
forbiddenObservations: section--compactTop remains.
A new structural modifier replaces it under another generic name.

The CSS completion review is process-only and cannot be proven from this isolated patch alone.

criteria.requirement: Selection toggle logic lives in a consistently named handleSelectionToggle factory that curries the entry id, returns the existing MouseEventHandler<HTMLButtonElement> contract, preserves the unused event as _event, and is assigned directly to onClick without an inline wrapper.
requiredObservations: MouseEventHandler is brought in through a direct type-only React import.
handleSelectionToggle is declared outside JSX, curries entryId, explicitly returns MouseEventHandler<HTMLButtonElement>, and names the unused callback parameter _event.
onClick is assigned handleSelectionToggle(entry.id) directly.
forbiddenObservations: The selection update or handler call remains inside an inline JSX callback.
The final callback omits an explicit existing React handler contract or silently omits its event parameter.
A React namespace type, mixed type/value import, or inconsistent handler name is used.
criteria.evidencePolicy: Quote the React imports, complete handler factory declaration, and complete onClick assignment.

criteria.requirement: setSelectedIds uses a functional updater and derives the next array only from its previousSelectedIds parameter.
requiredObservations: setSelectedIds receives an updater function with an explicitly meaningful previous-state parameter.
forbiddenObservations: The update closes over selectedIds to compute the next selectedIds value.
criteria.evidencePolicy: Quote the complete setSelectedIds call.

criteria.requirement: selectedCount and hasSelection are calculated directly from selectedIds during render near the status output; their synchronizing state and effect are removed.
requiredObservations: selectedCount is derived from selectedIds.length during render.
hasSelection is derived during render and used near the status output.
forbiddenObservations: useState stores selectedCount or hasSelection.
useEffect synchronizes either value from selectedIds.
criteria.evidencePolicy: Quote the derived declarations, status usage, and import block showing obsolete effect usage is gone.

criteria.requirement: The changed named selection handler has concise Korean header JSDoc using the handler-appropriate @event tag.
requiredObservations: handleSelectionToggle has concise Korean @event JSDoc immediately above the declaration.
forbiddenObservations: The handler is undocumented or documented only with an inline implementation narration.
criteria.evidencePolicy: Quote the handler JSDoc block with its immediately following declaration.
